title: The ring-valued positive residue coefficient tower
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite. Use the positive quotient rings $Q_n=A/(\varpi^{n+1})$ and the quotient factor maps $Q_m\to Q_n$ for $n\le m$ from [def-a1-finite-coefficient-sheaves]. Define $Q:\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{CRing}_{u+1}$ by $Q(n)=Q_n$ and $Q(n\to m)$ equal to that quotient map, so at the opposite of $n$ its exponent is $n+1$. This is the ring-valued diagram before applying any constant-sheaf functor; it has no scheme argument.
